title: A unified decision model for Bayesian ambiguity and non-affine statistics
abstract: arXiv:2610.21111v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies decision functionals under ambiguity when pure-risk evaluation is determined by a general, possibly non-affine statistic. We represent ambiguity perception by a Bayesian second-order model over first-order models and encode ambiguity attitude with a separate parameter. We formulate four consistency and monotonicity properties for decision functionals combining these objects. We show that second-order averaging does not generally preserve these properties for non-affine statistics, including expected shortfall, the industry-standard risk measure. To address this limitation, we introduce an ambiguity iron, a mapping from a second-order model and an ambiguity attitude to an ambiguity set of first-order models. Worst-case evaluation over this set preserves the chosen statistic as the pure-risk criterion. translated_title: 面向贝叶斯模糊性与非仿射统计量的统一决策模型
translated_abstract: 本文研究当纯风险评估由一般的、可能非仿射的统计量确定时，模糊性环境下的决策泛函。我们通过一个建立在一阶模型之上的贝叶斯二阶模型来刻画模糊性感知，并用一个独立的参数来编码模糊态度。我们为组合这些要素的决策泛函提出了四条一致性与单调性性质。我们证明，对于非仿射统计量——包括作为行业标准风险度量的期望损失——二阶平均通常无法保持这些性质。为解决这一局限，我们引入了“模糊熨平器”，即一个从二阶模型和模糊态度到一阶模型模糊集合的映射。在该集合上进行最坏情况评估，能够保持所选统计量作为纯风险评价准则。我们通过对二阶模型进行扭曲来构造模糊熨平器，并证明其产生的集合是凸且紧的。
tldr: 本文提出处理模糊性下非仿射统计量评估的统一决策模型，证明二阶平均会破坏非仿射统计量（如期望损失）的一致性与单调性，并提出“模糊熨平器”方法，通过在凸紧模糊集合上做最坏情况评估来在处理模糊性的同时保持所选纯风险准则。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified decision model for evaluating non-affine statistics under Bayesian ambiguity, shows that second-order averaging fails to preserve consistency and monotonicity for such statistics (including expected shortfall), and introduces an "ambiguity iron" whose worst-case evaluation over convex compact ambiguity sets preserves the chosen pure-risk statistic.
